relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright and tangy flavors of preserved lemon in the couscous complement the sweet, jammy taste of the Slow Tomato Confit.

relations.name: Miso Butter Ramen
relations.rationale: The rich, umami flavors of miso butter ramen can be enhanced by the sweet and garlicky Slow Tomato Confit, adding depth to the dish.

relations.name: Mojo rojo
relations.rationale: The spicy and tangy mojo rojo sauce pairs nicely with the sweetness of the Slow Tomato Confit, adding an extra layer of flavor.

relations.name: Original Mojo Verde from Tenerife
relations.rationale: The herbal notes in mojo verde can enhance the freshness of the thyme in the Slow Tomato Confit, creating a harmonious flavor profile.
